<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 428 926" width="428" height="926">
  <defs>

      <text x="12" y="42" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10px" fill="#FFFFFF">Profile</text>
    </g>
